judgement_source:
次タスク判断：選択肢 (b) — HOLD

MP-IMG2-W14は開始しません。現行の観測手段と認可範囲では、MP-IMG2 Decode Exitを完了できません。

GitHubの最新devがa03d755ea327f677b250b534af5e48e8bcb37d65であることを確認し、DC-MP-IMG2、実装計画§7.10・§19.65、ADR-0009を照合しました。

W1〜W
w1_w13: existing LIMITED TECHNICAL COMPLETION states stand

requirements.missing: process counters cannot isolate WIC-internal temporaries; no owned/lifetime/max measurement path
requirements.owner: new measurement design; Caller approves method and instrumentation
new measurement design; Windows/decoder measurement owner + Caller

requirements.missing: serial workers and non-atomic sampling cannot prove a peak under concurrency
requirements.owner: new measurement design; Caller approves parallel load, endpoints, tolerance or conservative bound

requirements.missing: W2 stop is process termination/reap, not cancellation inside synchronous WIC work
requirements.owner: new cancellation design; Caller decides whether in-decoder cancellation is required or process termination is the accepted limit

requirements.missing: W4 ROI is a post-OnLoad rectangle; a small output is not partial-decode evidence
requirements.owner: Caller design decision on decoder API, capability proof and fallback; may need new COM/FFI/dependency authority

requirements.missing: only pre-OnLoad refusal is proven; the 4K/64 MiB admission ceiling cannot measure it
requirements.owner: Caller design + measurement decision (support 16K or bound to derivative/preview)

requirements.missing: no codec-class-aligned peak scratch, cancellation capability and pixel tolerance
product dependency, licence, distribution and maintenance terms undecided
requirements.owner: new dependency/licence decision; WIC-only is permissible

requirements.missing: W5/W10 cover observation and explicit transform only; auto-apply, colour space and invalid-profile handling undecided

requirements.requirement: Product memory SLO and cancellation latency
requirements.missing: 768 MiB is an experiment stop bound, not a product SLO; no判定 endpoint under real load
decoder/version, dimensions, region capability, peak scratch, cancellation granularity and fallback cannot be fixed as one record
requirements.owner: Caller decoder selection and product fallback decision after evidence

requirements.missing: live human control approval unanswered; the retained executable is not startup proof
MP-RT6 authorization, authorized byte acquisition and real Runtime acceptance
requirements.owner: Runtime owner + Caller; fixture decode cannot substitute
separate Caller decision after Decode Exit

requirements.missing: Decode, Upload and Eviction gates all required

next: Caller must fix decode capability, measurement and product-acceptance decisions before any further slice is chosen
constraints_retained: Native SOURCE_FILES re-pin after any test edit
Gate-declared outputs fixed before the candidate
